concurrency._doc: Bounded Wave Scheduler — operational rules in CLAUDE.md § BWS. max_inflight_subagents cap enforced in check_routing.py; serialize_verify blocks verification while wave units are active. session_budget_pct: cumulative fan-out cap (BWS-T2-004, unboundedOrchestrator obs-4) — once a session's actual cumulative subagent dispatch cost (agent_call_stats.json cumulative_cost_usd) reaches this fraction of session_cost_budget.budget_usd, new Task/Agent dispatch is denied via _session_dispatch_cap_active in routing_state_manager.py. session_budget_override_limit: opt-in bounded escape from that cap; 0 (default) disables it, N>0 lets a dispatch containing the token session-budget-override bypass the cap up to N times per session (dispatch-budget-override does not apply). Deliberately lower than session_cost_budget.warning_pcts' high_water mark so fan-out is capped before the escape-hatch (_dispatch_debt_active) needs to engage.

bands._doc: DGC-002 dispatch context bands (tokens). min_useful_work_tokens / expected_output_tokens per model tier; target_min < target_max <= hard_limit; safety_reserve_tokens held back from the window. mode: off|warn|enforce, missing/invalid -> warn.

enforce_decision._doc: DGC-002 evidence ceilings before a dispatch_context gate may move from warn to enforce. fp_ceiling_* are false-positive rates and must lie in (0,1); sample_bounds_* bound the upper confidence limit.

dispatch_context._resume_ttl_constraint: HARD LIMIT: resume_ttl_seconds must never exceed 300 (5 min). Anthropic subagent prompt cache TTL is 5 min — resuming after cache expiry pays full cold-write price (1.25x base input on entire prefix), making resume MORE expensive than a fresh spawn. This is a cost protection rule, not a bug. Raising this value silently degrades cost savings.

progress_ledger._doc: Bounded Wave Scheduler — operational rules in CLAUDE.md § BWS. max_stall_markers: consecutive tool calls without progress markers before deny; null/absent disables stall detection. max_stall_seconds: wall-clock ceiling (TICKET-037) independent of tool-call count, so orchestrator workers on design/refactor steps — which make far fewer tool calls per minute than shell/mutation workers — still surface a partial-report checkpoint at least once every 2-3 minutes, matching the shell-worker convention. Either threshold tripping denies; null/absent disables that check only. worker_overrides (TICKET-039): per dispatch-schema `worker` type (mutation, read) overrides for either key, resolved via the dispatch_registry.json `dispatch_worker` field recorded at SubagentStart; a worker type with no entry here, or a dispatch whose worker type can't be resolved, falls back to the top-level keys above unchanged. mutation/read get a longer, ~10-minute-class wall-clock ceiling (600s) since diagnose-then-edit and search-then-report cycles legitimately run longer between narrated checkpoints than shell/orchestrator's tighter 3-minute cadence.

kill._doc: DGC-002 progress-ledger kill switch: grace_denied_calls denied calls tolerated before a stalled worker is flagged. mode: off|warn|enforce, missing/invalid -> warn.

strict_profile._doc: DGC-103: strict stall thresholds for shell/orchestrator workers. Inert until gate enforcement is enabled. These values are NOT read by dispatch_enforcer._stall_thresholds_for() until the strict profile gate ships; they are present here as a reference and for validation only.

continuation._doc: DGC-002 continuation manifest limits for chained subagent dispatches. mode: off|warn|enforce, missing/invalid -> warn.

routing_matrix._doc: Maps work_complexity intent to model assignments per role and dispatch limits. Used by OC-1 gate, PROD-19 gate. max_round_trips keys are retained for legacy tolerance but are no longer enforced by any gate — budget enforcement now flows through _dispatch_debt_active() in check_routing.py. test_runner is enforced by scripts/enforce_test_runner_model.py (pre_task gate): a dispatch whose prompt implies running a test suite must declare model=test_runner for the session's intent, or it is denied and told to split into a separate test_runner-tier shell dispatch instead of chaining into a reasoning-tier worker. Opus subagent dispatches are permanently blocked by scripts/enforce_explicit_model.py. effort (low|medium|high|xhigh|max) is set per intent independently of model tier; a sonnet worker on a bounded sub-task may run below high.

verification_tiers._doc: TICKET-040 (fix-7): documents the tiered verification policy implemented in scripts/verification_tier.py and wired into the bulk-verify gate in scripts/check_routing.py. Not read by any gate directly (no numeric knobs to tune) — the classification rule and keyword list live in verification_tier.py as the single source of truth; this entry exists for discoverability per the config.json convention.
verification_tiers.light: single-file mutation dispatch (files list length 1), pattern fully decided, no schema/API-surface-change keyword in pattern/why/constraints -> a targeted single-file test run is sufficient; no mandatory full independent re-run.
verification_tiers.full: anything else (multi-file, orchestrator/design dispatch, or a schema/API/contract/migration keyword present) -> existing mandatory full independent bulk-verify subagent re-run, unchanged.

context_pressure._doc: RC-7 live main-session context gate. ratio = last main-session assistant usage (input + cache_read + cache_creation) / model context window. mode: off = no-op; warn = never deny, report would_deny and bump would_deny:context_pressure; enforce = deny at ratio >= threshold. Missing/invalid mode -> warn. Unknown model window (default fallback) fails open.

token_estimation._doc: A positive value forces every model to this context window size; 0 disables the override.

pricing_per_1k._comment: MVP-1: these two flat output-only prices exist only for the 'estimated savings if re-routed to fast tier' display in analyze_routing.py's over-route report. They intentionally mirror scripts/pricing.json's sonnet/haiku output_per_1k so the two files don't drift silently apart — the real, per-model, input+output cost math for /cost-report lives in scripts/pricing.json via price_for(), not here. If you edit pricing.json's sonnet or haiku output_per_1k, update these two to match.

tune_savings._explore_sonnet_waste_usd_deprecated: MVP-1: replaced by _model_utils.explore_sonnet_waste_usd(), which derives this live from pricing.json's sonnet output price * explore_avg_tokens above, instead of a hardcoded dollar figure that can go stale when pricing changes. Kept here as a comment, not read by any script.

model_tiers._doc: Per-host Task/Agent model IDs grouped by cost tier. haiku and composer-2.5-fast are the same fast tier on Claude Code vs Cursor. Gates resolve tier via tier_of_model(); these slugs appear in denial messages.
